title: English Practice Quiz 0087
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: They said, 'We have finished.'
questions.explanation: Present perfect commonly shifts to past perfect in reported speech.

questions.question: I think it ___ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Will plus the base verb can express a future prediction.

questions.question: When I was five, I ___ swim.
There isn't ___ milk left.
questions.explanation: Milk is uncountable, so use much in a negative sentence.

questions.question: She ___ the report before the manager arrived.
questions.explanation: Use the past perfect for an action completed before another past action.

questions.question: You look tired. You ___ get some rest.
Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: Use does + subject + base verb with he, she or it.

questions.question: How ___ apples do you need?
questions.explanation: Apples are countable plural nouns, so use many.

questions.question: Water ___ at 100°C at sea level.
questions.explanation: Use the present simple for general facts.
